answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed tasks that independent counterparties verify, with each verified delivery increasing a bond-backed reputation score. A new identity starts with no score and must lock scarce tokens before bidding; failed or disputed work burns part of that bond. Splitting into many identities therefore does not multiply influence: each must separately fund bonds and build a track record, imposing real capital and time costs. A saffron pigment shipment to a reef-monitoring project could serve as one test task.
